newBusiness.name: My Reformer Space
newBusiness.address: София, ж.к. Левски Г, бул. Владимир Вазов 39, ет. 3

municipal.pointScope: Unique municipal postal row for the numbered building in Sofia. The exact floor comes from the owner; the postal point is not advertised as a surveyed door or separate floor position.

newBusiness.areaCorroboration: The public booking-provider business profile identifies the same merchant and floor 3 at Владимир Вазов 39 and names Левски Г. The merchant-authored promotional listing also places Studio 1 at this Левски Г address. These sources corroborate the quarter and premise only; their promotions, terms, images, prices and scheduling are not used as the offer source. The terms' corporate management address is not the training venue.

booking.evidence: Followed the owner's actual public calendar CTA and rendered the public menu. It visibly offers group training in Studio 1 with a place-reservation action. No action or date was selected. The owner FAQ separately states that phone reservations are accepted; the owner tariff publishes the same direct number immediately beside its reservation options. Only the priced phone channel is represented. No online price, live slot, or GoRez-confirmed booking is claimed.

newBusiness.openingHoursEvidence: The owner contact page states 07:00–21:00 daily, with training by reservation and according to schedule. These are business opening hours, not bookable class slots.

service.name: Пилатес реформър – еднократна групова тренировка
service.descriptionEn: One prebooked 50-minute group class. VAT is included. MultiSport cards are not accepted. Cancel at least 24 hours before the class; the published online terms charge the full price for late cancellation or a no-show.

newBusiness.termsScope: The owner FAQ and visitor guide state the general 24-hour cancellation window. The full-charge qualification for late cancellation/non-attendance comes specifically from section 4 of the owner online service terms, and is labeled accordingly in the service description. It is not represented as an unstated phone-specific charge or based on an external provider.
newBusiness.excluded: No workshop promotion, single-visit price derived from a class card, individual fee, medical claim, partner status, copied assets, ratings, studio branch duplication, unverified online price or slot. No testing data were entered; no communications, booking, payment, or production writes were made.
